# Test vens enrich writes owasp_severity from the OWASP rating's severity band

exec vens enrich --vex vex.json --output enriched-report.json report.json

exists enriched-report.json

# Pin the full enriched report: json-eq fails on a dropped key, an empty
# band, or any CVE the enrich loop touches that we did not account for.
json-eq enriched-report.json expected.json

-- vex.json --
{
  "bomFormat": "CycloneDX",
  "specVersion": "1.6",
  "vulnerabilities": [
    {
      "id": "CVE-2024-1234",
      "ratings": [
        {
          "method": "OWASP",
          "score": 45.5,
          "severity": "high",
          "vector": "SL:7/M:7/O:7/S:7/ED:6/EE:6/A:6/ID:3/LC:7/LI:7/LAV:7/LAC:7/FD:7/RD:7/NC:7/PV:7"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "CVE-2024-5678",
      "ratings": [
        {
          "method": "OWASP",
          "score": 12
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
